rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for covering a broad physical area or many places.

example.english: We searched widely but still couldn’t find it.
example.traditional: 我哋周圍搵過，都搵唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zau1 wai4 wan2 gwo3 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this to frame a generalization, especially when English means “generally speaking.”

example.english: Generally speaking, this practice is widely used in Hong Kong companies.
example.traditional: 一般嚟講，呢個做法喺香港公司好普遍。
example.jyutping: jat1 bun1 lei4 gong2 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 gung1 si1 hou2 pou2 pin3

rows.note: Use this when something is common or generally true across people or cases, rather than as a discourse opener.

example.english: This illness is widely found among older people.
example.traditional: 呢種病喺老人家之間好普遍。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 beng6 hai2 lou5 jan4 gaa1 zi1 gaan1 hou2 pou2 pin3

rows.note: Use this when “widely” means to a great degree, emphasizing how much something changes or increases.

example.english: The new system has widely improved people’s access to doctors.
example.traditional: 新制度大大咁改善咗市民睇醫生嘅情況。
example.jyutping: san1 zai6 dou6 daai6 daai6 gam3 goi2 sin6 zo2 si5 man4 tai2 ji1 sang1 ge3 cing4 fong3
